title: merge --batch-build lists each reviewed-done PR that no batch holds, with its reason
why: Runner 10 left #2990 out of batch 120 by omission (00:46 CST Nov 13): merge --reviewed reads it done (round 3, net value zero) and nothing holds it, but the batch was built from the coordinator's ordered list and the runner's own 21:44 CST list, which lost it. Rule building-never-drop-item-silently.
note: merge --batch-build prints each PR that merge --reviewed reads done and no batch holds, with its reason (prose, conflict, held, or none). Red test first with #2990's shape. #2990 goes in the next code batch.
